name: tia_get_block_code
description: Read the code of a PLC block. By default (format 'auto') SCL, STL and DB blocks return the source text TIA Portal generates (Source, file extension .scl/.awl/.db) without SimaticML; other languages (LAD, FBD, GRAPH) and blocks whose source cannot be generated return SimaticML in XmlContent, with the reason in Warnings. format 'xml' always returns SimaticML; format 'source' fails instead of falling back. Source generation needs the PLC offline in TIA Portal. The source of a single SCL block (without dependencies) can be edited and passed to tia_import_scl_block. ExtractedScl is a deprecated copy of Source for SCL blocks.

block_name.description: Name of the block to export (e.g. 'Main', 'PumpControl', 'DB_Config').

plc_name.description: Name of the target PLC (optional, defaults to first PLC).

format.description: 'auto' (default): generated source for SCL/STL/DB blocks, SimaticML otherwise or when generation fails. 'source': generated source only, fails if not possible. 'xml': SimaticML only.

include_xml.description: Also return the SimaticML in XmlContent when source text is returned (default false; the XML is often 80-100 kB).

with_dependencies.description: Generate the source together with the blocks and types it depends on (default false). Such output holds several blocks and cannot be passed to tia_import_scl_block.
